The `UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt) because the Keystore AES key was generated with `setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `setUserAuthenticationParameters(30, ...)`. When initialized during `Cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key())`, the Keystore requires recent biometric or device credential authentication, which has not occurred when the user signs in with their library card.

### Changes Made

In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt):
1. Removed `setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)` from `KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder` so the key does not require explicit user authentication for encryption and decryption.
2. Added fallback handling in `save()`: if an existing key created with the old auth requirements is still present in the Keystore, it deletes the stale key and generates a new one.
3. Wrapped cipher operations in `load()` with a `try-catch` to safely return `null` if decryption cannot be performed.
